name: cloud-marketplace
description: Local marketplace — Diego's declarative Claude Code plugins (cloud principles, split 2026-07-30 into 4 focused plugins, + ponytail), source-of-truth in ~/git/unix.

plugins.name: hooks-stack-framework-principles-cloud-ai-plugin
plugins.description: Core engine: CORE PRINCIPLES + FIRE rules + repo reference injected at SessionStart, plus PreToolUse:Bash guard (allow/deny/warn) and PostToolUse nudge. Replaces static CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: compression-cloud-ai-plugin
plugins.description: Steady-state context compression: per-turn/per-bash one-line principles pointer instead of re-injecting the full set every turn.

plugins.name: memory-system-cloud-ai-plugin
plugins.description: Memory structure rule: MEMORY.md is an index, not a preload bundle — entries live in type subfolders, loaded on demand only.

plugins.name: sub-agents-cloud-ai-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffold — reserved for future sub-agent / Task-tool orchestration principles. No active rules yet.

plugins.name: skill-claude-api-plugin
plugins.description: Claude API / Anthropic SDK skill, delivered as a plugin (no loose ~/.claude/skills).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy-senior-dev mode: forces the simplest solution that works (YAGNI, stdlib-first).
